investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocks All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-18T00:27:16Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production API's POST /api/agents call could not reach the swarm gateway ELB at the /v1/agents endpoint. Because the failure is shared across all sibling checks with the exact same error message, the fault is localized to the swarm gateway or its upstream load balancer, not to any individual eval check or eval runner logic.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2) was unreachable from the production API at the time of the eval run. Every remote-agents check depends on POST /api/agents successfully proxying to the swarm gateway's /v1/agents endpoint; when that gateway returned a connection error, the production API surfaced HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and no agent was provisioned. All required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) are therefore absent because the createAgent call never completed. This is an eval-observed infrastructure availability failure scoped to the swarm gateway dependency; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so broader production impact cannot be confirmed from this packet alone.
